scenario: Reject an adapter missing one required operation
preconditions: Client has no txn or lease API method
procedure_reference: Construct EtcdV3CoordinatorAuthorityStore with incomplete driver
expected_result: Constructor rejects before accepting requests
notes: Port contract does not certify client behavior

scenario: Use linearizable Range for authority decisions
preconditions: Etcd v3 client driver configured
procedure_reference: Read leader/scope state through the adapter
expected_result: Range call is made with serializable=false
required_evidence: Recorded request consistency option and returned revision

scenario: Do not use serializable member-local reads for Leader validation
preconditions: A stale local replica response is possible
procedure_reference: Attempt to configure or inject serializable read path
expected_result: Safety API does not allow it and fails closed if response lacks expected revision
notes: Watch is also not a linearizable read

scenario: Create absent scope key with version=0 guard
preconditions: Scope key is absent
procedure_reference: Txn compare VERSION==0 then put scope record
expected_result: Exactly one transaction creates key
required_evidence: Txn succeeded flag and key revision
notes: etcd adapter maps Compare and Txn

scenario: Reject stale mod_revision compare
preconditions: Two writers read the same key revision
procedure_reference: Both submit compare MOD==observed revision with different values
expected_result: At most one Txn succeeds; loser reads current state and retries with same logical operation only after reconciliation
required_evidence: Txn outcomes and latest key value/revision
notes: Single-process fake does not prove cluster consistency

scenario: Persist scope high-water and operation intent in one transaction
preconditions: Leader and scope revisions are known
procedure_reference: Txn conditionally updates scope token and operation ledger
expected_result: Both values change at one revision or neither success branch write occurs
required_evidence: Top-level revision and both key values
notes: No split writes across multiple transactions

scenario: Execute only success or failure branch
preconditions: Compare evaluates false
procedure_reference: Txn has disjoint success and failure mutations
expected_result: Only failure branch mutates state
notes: Failure branch must not accidentally apply success writes

scenario: Handle lost response after successful commit
preconditions: Txn reaches etcd but client response is lost
procedure_reference: Inject network timeout after commit; linearizable-read the idempotency key and operation record
expected_result: Return OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and reconcile committed state without creating a new ID
synthetic_only: stored operation identity and reconciliation record
column12: Never blindly replay a mutating Txn

scenario: Attach leader key to a backend lease
preconditions: No current leader key exists
procedure_reference: Grant lease then create leader key in a conditional transaction
expected_result: Leader key stores new identity and is attached to returned lease ID
required_evidence: Lease ID/TTL and key lease field

scenario: Fail closed when KeepAlive cannot be confirmed
preconditions: Coordinator currently owns a leader lease
procedure_reference: Inject network failure or TTL=0 response to KeepAlive
expected_result: Leader is treated as not authorized for new mutations/proofs
column12: Do not rely only on client wall clock

scenario: Remove leader key on expired lease
preconditions: Leader key is attached to a lease
procedure_reference: Stop keepalive until lease expires
expected_result: Key is removed and future Leader compare fails
synthetic_only: deleted key and new election revision

scenario: Use LeaderKey revision and lease in every state mutation
preconditions: A LeaderKey was returned by Election Campaign
procedure_reference: Read LeaderKey key/create revision/lease; issue state Txn with compares
expected_result: Txn accepts only while LeaderKey ownership matches
column12: A cached campaign response is not permanent authority

scenario: Fence an old Coordinator after takeover
preconditions: Leader A loses lease; Leader B obtains a newer LeaderKey revision
procedure_reference: Resume Leader A and submit old revision/value compare
expected_result: Old Leader transaction fails before state or proof mutation
column12: Previously issued short-lived proof still needs downstream fencing

scenario: Show lease alone does not prevent a paused old writer
preconditions: Old process pauses beyond TTL while holding a cached lease object
procedure_reference: Resume old process and attempt external Provider write without fencing
expected_result: System must reject unsafe mode; Provider enforces high-water/CAS independent of lease cache
column12: etcd Lease/Lock does not protect arbitrary external resources

scenario: Do not authorize from Watch event absence
preconditions: Watch is disconnected or event history was compacted
procedure_reference: Reestablish watch and inspect cached state before fresh linearizable Range
expected_result: No authorization until current state read is confirmed
synthetic_only: compact error and subsequent Range revision

scenario: Fail closed if cluster majority is unavailable
preconditions: etcd cluster cannot form quorum
procedure_reference: Attempt Leader/Txn/lease refresh and coordinator mutations
expected_result: No new authority or Provider proof is issued
synthetic_only: failed calls and no mutation evidence

scenario: Reconcile in-flight transaction during leader election
preconditions: A Txn is sent near an etcd leader transition
procedure_reference: Drop response and query original idempotency operation after cluster recovers
expected_result: Result is reconstructed from linearizable state; uncommitted work is not reported committed
synthetic_only: returned Txn outcome and resulting keys
column12: Unknown response remains unknown until read-back

scenario: Prevent tenant from modifying another tenant's coordinator keys
preconditions: Multi-tenant key namespace and scoped etcd roles exist
procedure_reference: Attempt cross-tenant read/write and direct leader key mutation
expected_result: Unauthorized operations are denied by etcd auth policy
column12: No mTLS/RBAC deployment in this repository

scenario: Prevent snapshot restore from rolling back fencing token/sequence
preconditions: Coordinator/etcd snapshot may be older than Provider control object
procedure_reference: Restore in an isolated cluster; compare external Provider token/sequence floors before enabling writes
expected_result: Writes remain blocked until floors are reconciled and pending operations are reviewed
column12: Store snapshot revision alone is not Provider state

scenario: Enforce etcd token at object-store control-object CAS
preconditions: etcd transaction allocated a new scope token; provider proof is signed
procedure_reference: Race old/new Coordinator proofs against Provider control-object CAS
expected_result: Only current high-water token may publish/revoke/activate
